correct_completion: she handed it to the director.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, she handed it to the director.
acceptable_variants: she gave it to the director.
she submitted it to the director.

options.text: she handing it to the director.
options.why_wrong: The -ing form cannot work as a finite main verb here; the sentence needs a past tense verb.

options.text: she handed it to the director.
to hand it to the director.
options.why_wrong: An infinitive cannot express the completed main action, so the sequence of events is not shown.

options.text: it was being handed to the director by her.
options.why_wrong: The progressive passive describes an ongoing action, while the stem requires a completed action before the main verb.

explanation: The perfect participle 'Having finished' shows an action completed before the main verb. The main clause then needs a finite past tense verb after the comma. Speakers may be tempted to use a gerund or an infinitive here, but English requires a finite verb.
